summary: The article accurately reports on Reliance Industries' promoter and mutual fund stake increases, as well as the company's Q1FY26 financial results, aligning with multiple financial news sources.

claims.claim: Promoters of Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) significantly increased their stake to 50.5% by June 2025, marking the highest level in over three years.
claims.note: Promoter stake increased to 50.5% by June 2026, highest in over three years. Some sources state 50.48%.

claims.claim: Indian mutual funds also boosted their holding in RIL to 10.11% by June 2025.
claims.note: Mutual fund holding increased to 10.11% by June 2026.

claims.claim: This increase was by 0.5 percentage points from the previous quarter's 50% holding.
claims.note: Promoter stake rose to 50.5% from 50% at the end of the March quarter.

claims.claim: Indian mutual funds have significantly raised their holding in RIL, reaching 10.11% by June 2025, up from 9.78% at the end of the March quarter.
claims.note: Mutual fund holding increased to 10.11% from 9.78% at the end of the March quarter.

claims.claim: Domestic institutional investor (DII) shareholding also rose to 21.04% from 20.41% sequentially.
claims.note: DII shareholding rose to 21.04% from 20.41% sequentially.

claims.claim: For Q1 FY26, RIL reported consolidated revenue from operations at ₹3,11,850 crore, growing 4.43% sequentially.
claims.note: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY26 was ₹3,11,850 crore.

claims.claim: Consolidated net profit attributable to owners reached ₹20,946 crore, jumping 23.42% quarter-on-quarter, reversing sequential profit pressures.
Consolidated EBITDA increased 8% sequentially to ₹47,517 crore, with EBITDA margin expanding by 40 bps to 15.4%.

article_title: Reliance Industries: Promoter Stake Hits 3-Year High in Q1FY26
